sql: SELECT count(*) FROM Customer
SELECT T1.Name FROM Album AS T1 JOIN Artist AS T2 ON T1.ArtistId = T2.ArtistId GROUP BY T1.ArtistId ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT T1.FirstName, T1.LastName, COUNT(T2.CustomerId) FROM Customer AS T1 JOIN Employee AS T2 ON T1.CustomerId = T2.CustomerId GROUP BY T1.FirstName, T1.LastName

SELECT a.Name FROM Artist a JOIN Album al ON a.ArtistId = al.ArtistId JOIN InvoiceLine il ON al.AlbumId = il.AlbumId JOIN Invoice i ON il.InvoiceId = i.InvoiceId JOIN Playlist p ON i.PlaylistId = p.PlaylistId JOIN PlaylistTrack pt ON p.PlaylistId = pt.PlaylistId JOIN Track t ON pt.TrackId = t.TrackId WHERE t.GenreId IN (SELECT g.GenreId FROM Genre g GROUP BY g.GenreId HAVING COUNT(g.GenreId) > 1)

SELECT SUM(T1.Total) AS RunningTotal, T1.Month FROM InvoiceLine AS T1 JOIN Invoice AS T2 ON T1.InvoiceId = T2.InvoiceId WHERE T2.BillingDate >= '2022-01-01' AND T2.BillingDate < '2022-12-31' GROUP BY T1.Month ORDER BY T1.Month

```sql
SELECT 
    iso3,
    SUM(population) AS combined_population,
    year
FROM 
    country_stats
GROUP BY 
    iso3, 
    year
ORDER BY 
    year;
```

SELECT T1.name, T2.gdp_usd
FROM countries AS T1
JOIN country_stats AS T2 ON T1.iso3 = T2.iso3
WHERE T2.year = 2023
ORDER BY T2.gdp_usd DESC;

```sql
SELECT iso3, name, gdp_usd, gdp_per_capita_usd, life_expectancy_years, fertility_rate, urban_population_pct, internet_users_pct
FROM country_stats
WHERE internet_users_pct < 10 AND internet_users_pct > 50
  AND year BETWEEN 2010 AND 2023;
```
SELECT AVG(flipper_length_mm) FROM penguins
SELECT COUNT(species) FROM penguins WHERE bill_length_mm > (SELECT AVG(bill_length_mm) FROM penguins);
SELECT MAX(MPG) FROM cars_data WHERE MakeId IN (SELECT MakeId FROM car_names WHERE Model = '8 cylinder') AND Year < 1980
SELECT count(*) FROM employee
SELECT T1.Paragraph_ID, T1.Paragraph_Text FROM Documents AS T1 JOIN Paragraphs AS T2 ON T1.Document_ID = T2.Document_ID WHERE T1.Document_Name = 'Welcome to NY'
SELECT AVG(winner_age) AS avg_winner_age, AVG(loser_age) AS avg_loser_age FROM matches
SELECT T2.semester_name FROM Transcript_Contents AS T1 JOIN Students AS T2 ON T1.student_course_id = T2.student_course_id WHERE T1.transcript_id IS NULL
SELECT count(*) FROM poker_player
SELECT COUNT(T1.Name) FROM country AS T1 JOIN countrylanguage AS T2 ON T1.Code = T2.CountryCode WHERE T2.Language = 'English' AND T2.IsOfficial = 'T'
SELECT T1.name, COUNT(T2.student_id) FROM Friend AS T1 JOIN Likes AS T2 ON T1.student_id = T2.student_id GROUP BY T1.name

SELECT T1.first_name FROM Professionals AS T1 JOIN Dogs AS T2 ON T1.professional_id = T2.professional_id WHERE T2.name NOT IN (SELECT T1.first_name FROM Dogs AS T2 ON T1.professional_id = T2.professional_id)
